name: billing-book
prompt: The Charge methods of CardPayer, BankPayer, WalletPayer and VoucherPayer in package billing do nearly the same thing. Make all four call one package-level function book(charged *[]string, method, to, text string), which logs "<method> charge to <to>" with the standard logger and appends "<to>: <text>" to *charged. What they charge and log must not change.

name: billing-blocked
prompt: Accounts can block payment methods. Add a field Blocked map[string]bool to billing.Account, keyed by a method's name (what Payer.Name returns). Collect does not charge through a method the account blocked, and that account's summary line lists only the methods it charged through.

name: billing-methods
prompt: Replace the fields Card and Bank of billing.Account with one field Methods map[string]string, keyed by method name: "card" for the card number and "bank" for the bank account number. Everything that used them, in every package, must work as before.

name: billing-tail
prompt: last is used only by CardPayer. Replace it with a method func (c *CardPayer) tail(number string) string that keeps the last 4 bytes of number, the digits a card shows, and remove last. What CardPayer's methods return and charge must not change.

name: billing-run
prompt: Collect should take its accounts and invoice as one value. Add a type billing.Run struct { Accounts []Account; Invoice Invoice } and change Collect to func Collect(c Config, r Run) []string, updating every caller in every package. What it charges and returns must not change.
